name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Cameroon to release five jailed journalists: Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad. It also asks Cameroon to stop putting civilians on trial in military courts and to respect press freedom, especially before the 2025 presidential election. It calls on the European Union and its member states to raise these cases with Cameroon's authorities and to use their influence to improve human rights.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- The five named journalists and Cameroon's treatment of reporters are the focus.
- The European Union and member states are asked to press Cameroon's authorities.
